title: Usable Unusables
description: adds use to some useless items and also some crafting recipes
body:
A simple mod that gives use to some previewsly unusable or useless items.

not only that but it also adds some crafting recipes to some items that would be nearly unusable in a regular survival world.

The mod currently adds uses for the following :
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Poisonous potato - can be turned into regular potatoes and then into french fries.
- Rotten flesh - can be cooked into Rotten steak a bad source of food but not useless.
- Spider eye - can be cooked into cooked spider eye which gives night vision or you can use them for a spider eye stew which elongates the effect.

</details>
 It also gives recipes to the following items:
 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- All horse armour - crafted with a leather horse armour and 6 of the material of the wanted tier of armour.
- Name tag - crafted with 1 leather, 1 iron, 1 paper and 1 ink sac.
- Bell - crafted with 3 gold, 1 gold nugget and one of any wood.
- Gilded Blackstone - 2 gold nuggets, 2 blackstone.
- Saddle - 3 leather, 2 strings and 2 tripwire hooks.

</details>
